description_en: Grants special travel permissions to enterprise employees
description_zh: 调用本接口，可实现为企业员工授予特殊差旅权限
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen isv-rule-save --user-id user_1234 --book-type authorizedPerson --status 1 --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: IsvRuleSave

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.
When calling this operation over HTTP, include this as a required parameter in the request URL. For information about how to obtain the token, refer to Enterprise Access Token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
When appending this parameter, you can use `crop_token=value` as a substitute
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。
通过 HTTP 方式进行接口调用时，需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
在拼接时，可以使用`crop_token=value`替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_so_corp_token

parameters.help_en: The type of role permission granted to the employee
parameters.help_zh: 为员工授予的角色权限类型
parameters.name: book_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the authorization takes effect
parameters.name: status

fields.help_en:
The ID of the employee who can be booked for.
You can specify up to 300 employee IDs.
If the number exceeds the limit of 300, you can use `entity_type=4` to pass values at the department level
fields.help_zh:
可被代订人员 ID。
最多传入300位员工的 ID。
若人数超出 300 的限制，可以使 `entitp_type=4` ，按部门维度传值
fields.name: entity_id

fields.help_en:
The scope in which the booking agent permission takes effect.
Takes effect only when `book_type = bookPerson`.
If this scope is not set, the permission takes effect for all employees by default
fields.help_zh:
代订权限生效范围。
仅 `book_type = bookPerson` 时生效。
本范围不设置默认为全员生效
fields.name: entity_type

parameters.help_en: The list of users for whom the booking agent permission takes effect
parameters.help_zh: 代订人权限生效范围列表
parameters.name: bookuser_list

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the current employee needs to submit a travel approval request when making a booking
parameters.help_zh: 当前人员预订是否需要提交出差审批单
parameters.name: apply_need

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the current employee is subject to travel policy restrictions when making a booking
parameters.help_zh: 当前人员预订是否受差标影响
parameters.name: rule_need

module.description_en: The response message. Deprecated. Use the `message` parameter instead
module.description_zh: 返回信息。已废弃，请使用 `message` 参数

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of this request

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

traceId.description_en: The global trace identifier of the request, typically used for troubleshooting
traceId.description_zh: 跟踪请求全局的标识符，通常用于问题排查定位
